HSIMS.ca.t|/phases/3/p: The plant mixes for more than 45 seconds. Then select the poker vibrator and hold the pointer on the pour: the concrete is placed in layers and fully compacted — honeycombs and voids are not sealed by crystals.
HSIMS.ca.t|/phases/3/done: Concrete placed and fully compacted, without cold joints.
HSIMS.ca.t|/phases/4/q: The second truck arrives stiff after a long drive. The foreman asks for 10 l of water per m³ in the drum.
HSIMS.ca.t|/phases/4/opts/0: No — no water on site: it raises the w/c ratio beyond the recipe. Consistency is adjusted with the superplasticiser of the recipe.
HSIMS.ca.t|/phases/4/opts/1: Yes — 10 l/m³ is harmless, the admixture seals the pores anyway
HSIMS.ca.t|/phases/4/opts/2: Yes, but add BETOCRETE as well to compensate
HSIMS.ca.t|/phases/4/why: No additional water on site: it raises the w/c ratio beyond the recipe; the crystalline effect works in a dense concrete.
HSIMS.ca.t|/phases/5/p: Select the curing sheet and stay on the slab: the surfaces are protected against drying out, wind, sun and frost and kept damp to the valid standards. Crystals on the surface are not a defect.
HSIMS.ca.t|/phases/6/p: The formwork is struck when the strength allows; the concrete hardens — the crystalline effect needs the dense concrete the curing produces.
HSIMS.ca.t|/phases/7/p: The working space is backfilled; the ground water rises against the slab and the walls. The crystals close the pores.
HSIMS.ca.t|/phases/7/done: In the ground, under water pressure.
HSIMS.ca.t|/phases/8/p: A crack of up to 0.4 mm opens and the water reaches it: crystals grow in the crack until it is sealed. Wider or moving cracks are injected (AQUAFIN-P1, P4, IH).
HSIMS.ca.t|/res_title: The basement is watertight. Dense concrete, healing cracks.
HSIMS.ca.t|/res_sub: Concrete with BETOCRETE is produced, placed and cured to the currently valid standards; the admixture does not replace the craft. Observe the technical data sheets and the safety data sheets.
T|/hero.kicker: Waterproofing and Restoration · Crack sealing / injection resins
T|/hero.intro: {P4} is a two component polyurethane resin for crack sealing and for water penetration, on dry and damp substrates. Low viscosity, cures to soft elastic, excellent adhesion.
T|/hero.photoAlt: Underground car park in fair-faced concrete

T|/how.label: Mechanism
T|/how.title: How crack injection with {P4r} works
T|/how.sub: {P4} is grouted through injection packers into the crack. The low-viscosity resin fills the crack, cures to soft elastic and adheres to the crack flanks.
T|/how.steps/0/1: Drill the injection holes. Clear any drilling debris in the drilled holes using oil-free compressed air.
T|/how.steps/1/1: Insert one injection packer into each drilled hole.
T|/how.steps/2/1: Seal the inserted packers and the zone of the {defect} on the surface approx. 15 cm wide with {EKF}. Allow the crack insulation to cure.
T|/how.steps/3/1: Grout in the thoroughly mixed {P4} using a grouting device. Pot life approx. 30 minutes.
T|/how.steps/4/1: After the resin has cured, remove the injection packers and plug the boreholes flush with the surface using {M30}.
T|/how.modelAdesc: {P4} is used on dry and damp substrates. The {defect} is injected directly.
T|/how.modelBdesc: Where the {defect} conducts water, an initial injection of {P1} is necessary to stop the ingress of water. {P4} follows as the crack-bridging seal.
T|/how.note: Schematic, width of the {defect} exaggerated. Holes at 45° to the {defect}; hole diameter, packer type and spacing according to the project specification.

T|/m3d.microNote: Micro scale: schematic close-up of a sectioned sample, not to scale. Resin colours as supplied: AQUAFIN-P1 dark brown, AQUAFIN-P4 honey yellow.
T|/m3d.microSub: Micro scale shows the place where the drilled hole crosses the {defect}, inside the component: hardened cement paste with its pores and crystals, the hole, the packer, and how the two resins behave. Choose a stage; each one plays as a short animation.
T|/m3d.microNoteGlued: Micro scale: schematic close-up of a sectioned sample, not to scale. Resin colour as supplied: AQUAFIN-P4 honey yellow.
T|/calloutsMicroGlued/0/1: A sectioned sample of hardened cement paste: globular hydration products, air pores, plate-shaped and needle-shaped crystals, two broken aggregate grains. The crack runs through it with fine branches. Nothing is drilled: the component stays untouched.
T|/calloutsMicroGlued/1/1: The packers are bonded over the crack on the surface with {EKF}. The resin enters the crack from there at low pressure and runs along it into the depth of the component.
T|/calloutsMicroGlued/2/1: The honey yellow resin has a low viscosity (approx. 125 mPa·s at 20 °C), so it also reaches the fine branches. It adheres to the flanks and cures to soft elastic: the permanent, crack-bridging seal. Adhesive packers need a dry or damp crack that does not conduct water.
T|/calloutsMicro/0/1: A sectioned sample of hardened cement paste: globular hydration products, air pores, plate-shaped and needle-shaped crystals, two broken aggregate grains. The {defect} runs through it with fine branches. The section follows the axis of the drilled hole, so the hole shows as a half pipe that meets the {defect} at 45°.
T|/calloutsMicro/1/1: Only where the {defect} conducts water. The dark brown resin runs along the hole into the {defect}, reacts with the water and foams to up to 40 times its volume. The watertight, visco-plastic foam stops the ingress of water. It is a temporary seal.
T|/calloutsMicro/2/1: The honey yellow resin has a low viscosity (approx. 125 mPa·s at 20 °C), so it also reaches the fine branches that the foam does not fill. It adheres to the flanks and cures to soft elastic: the permanent, crack-bridging seal. Afterwards the packer is removed and the hole plugged with {M30}.
T|/m3d.hint: Drag to rotate · Shift + drag to pan
T|/m3d.fallback: The 3D view needs WebGL and an internet connection to load. The cross-section diagram in the section “Mechanism” shows the same sequence.
T|/callouts/0/1: {problem} Stage “Leak”: the damp surface shows where the water comes through.
T|/callouts/1/1: The injection packers sit in drilled holes that cross the {defect} inside the component. In X-ray view the holes pass between the reinforcing bars. Stage “Surface sealed” shows the {EKF} seal, approx. 15 cm wide.
T|/callouts/2/1: Stage “Sealed”: the {defect} is filled with {P4}, the packers are removed and the boreholes plugged flush with {M30}. The surface dries.
